purpose: This table is the cleaned runway-level dataset from OurAirports, one row per runway, feeding downstream joins to the airports table on airport_id and airport_identifier and any analysis of runway geometry, surface, and status.
usage: Join on airport_id (internal) or airport_identifier (external) to the airports silver table; filter is_closed = true out of operational analyses as needed; treat low_end_/high_end_ latitude, longitude, elevation, heading, and displaced_threshold columns as optional since they are frequently null and must not be imputed; surface_code is a free-text code, not a fixed enumeration, so match it defensively.
limitations: Geospatial and heading columns (low_end_/high_end_ latitude, longitude, elevation, heading) carry null_rates between 0.22 and 0.28, and the displaced_threshold columns carry null_rates of 0.88 and 0.90, reflecting genuine historical gaps in the source rather than errors; these were retained nullable, not imputed or dropped. surface_code was left as unvalidated free text because the publisher does not maintain a fixed code list. No duplicate rows were found (duplicate_row_rate 0.0) so no row-level dedupe was applied.
